title: A Uniform for the Clock
author: Xanthe Coldharbour
blurb: Rosalind Joubert, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
